Chanakya University vs Sapthagiri College of Engineering for MCA is not a clean same-city fee comparison until Sapthagiri's official circular is checked. Neither side has a placement row here.

sections.heading: Chanakya University vs Sapthagiri College of Engineering for MCA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Chanakya University if you want an official 2026-27 fee. The university lists MCA tuition of ₹2 lakh a year, a first-year payable fee of ₹2.05 lakh including registration, and a two-year programme total of ₹4.05 lakh. There is no Chanakya MCA placement row on this page.

Do not pick Sapthagiri College of Engineering on the basis of the recorded tuition of about ₹11,667. That figure is unusually low for a two-year MCA and may be an instalment or a mislabelled head, not a confirmed annual fee.

sections.heading: Fees: official figures and a flagged record
paragraphs: Chanakya University's official 2026-27 fee page lists MCA tuition at ₹2 lakh a year and a two-year total programme fee of ₹4.05 lakh. Registration of ₹5,000 brings the first-year payable amount to ₹2.05 lakh.

Sapthagiri College of Engineering has a recorded MCA tuition of ₹11,666.67 a year. This page does not treat that amount as a confirmed annual programme fee. Get the college's official MCA circular, including government-quota and management-quota heads if they differ.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Neither side has an MCA placement row on this page. There is no average or highest package we can quote.
Ask each institute for its latest official MCA placement report, and check that the figures are for MCA, not a mixed campus report.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Chanakya University has no entrance exam listed for MCA in our records on this page. Check the official admissions page for CUET-PG or a university test.

Sapthagiri College of Engineering has TANCET listed in our records. TANCET is a Tamil Nadu exam, and the college is listed under Bengaluru, with an address that also mentions Dharmapuri. Treat the exam and address as unverified until you check the official admissions page, which may instead use Karnataka PGCET or KMAT.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Chanakya University is listed at Devanahalli, on the Bengaluru outskirts.

Sapthagiri College of Engineering is listed in Bengaluru in this comparison, but the stored address also mentions Krishnagiri Main Road and Dharmapuri. Confirm the teaching campus from the official website before you assume it is in Bengaluru.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want an official 2026-27 MCA fee, Chanakya University is the side we can quote, at ₹2 lakh tuition a year and a ₹4.05 lakh two-year total, but you must ask for a placement report.
Sapthagiri's recorded tuition should not be used as a cheap annual fee until an official circular confirms it. Also confirm the campus and the accepted entrance exam.
Do not invent a missing package or a corrected fee without an official source.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Chanakya University or Sapthagiri College of Engineering, for MCA?
faqs.answer: Chanakya University has an official 2026-27 MCA tuition of ₹2 lakh a year and a two-year total of ₹4.05 lakh, with no placement row here. Sapthagiri has a recorded tuition of about ₹11,667 that this page does not treat as a confirmed annual fee, and no placement row.

faqs.question: What is the official Chanakya University MCA fee for 2026-27?
faqs.answer: The official fee page lists MCA tuition of ₹2 lakh a year, a first-year payable fee of ₹2.05 lakh including ₹5,000 registration, and a two-year programme total of ₹4.05 lakh.

faqs.question: Is Sapthagiri's recorded MCA fee of about ₹11,667 the annual fee?
faqs.answer: This page does not treat that figure as a confirmed annual programme fee. It is unusually low and may be an instalment or a mislabelled head. Confirm the official circular.

faqs.question: Does Sapthagiri College of Engineering accept TANCET for MCA?
faqs.answer: TANCET is listed in our records, but TANCET is a Tamil Nadu exam and the college is listed under Bengaluru. Confirm the accepted exam on the official admissions page.

faqs.question: Are MCA placements listed for these institutes?
